title: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 06 Project Research Scientist I, Project Nurse III and Project Technical Support III Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 06 Project Research Scientist I, Project Nurse III, and Project Technical Support III Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Any Degree, post-graduation, or B.Sc. Nursing can use this chance and apply for the AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 . Interested candidates can fill in the application before the last date of application. Here we provide more details about the age ...
